text:
Type: patterned wool runner rug
Use: covering a walkway; hallway, kitchen, entryway, bedroom
Style: contemporary, modern, bohemian
Materials: wool with a heathered textured pile
Colors: denim blue, light grey, white flecks
Shape: long narrow rectangle, tone-on-tone abstract diamond and leaf-like pattern, heathered surface, plain edges, soft pile, light visual weight
Feel: relaxed, cool, casual, soft
Goes with: light wood or parquet floors, teal or white cabinets, stainless steel; modern or coastal rooms

product.name: Rivet Motion Modern Patterned Wool Runner Rug, 2' 3" x 7' 6", Denim Blue
product.description: 100% Wool Imported A striking design features chic simplicity, flat weave, and beautiful shades of denim blue. Each rug is hand woven for texture and superior durability, with stylish depth and dimension. 2'3" x 7'6" Hand-tufted in India High pile height is provides extra comfort Pair with a rug pad, which is sold separately Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
